note: Logical locators used by workflows/*.yaml. As of the 2026-11-04 pass the authoritative vocabulary is the REAL on-screen text, captured over CDP on this machine (NasRunner.exe, --remote-debugging-port=9223, suite 2.11.0). Each entry keeps the UIA shape (names/controlType/automationId) so tools/uia_driver.py still works, and adds cdpText where CDP's text matching is the reliable path. Empty names + a note means this build has no such control - do not invent it back. Never put coordinates here.

window.note: This machine runs the portable bundle copy: C:\Users\SunCh\AppData\Local\AllPoweredFSA\app-0.2.0.0\original\NASRunner.exe --force-renderer-accessibility --remote-debugging-port=9223 (process name NASRunner). The Program Files install (NovAtelApplicationSuite.exe) is also present.

Refresh ports.note: No such button. The New Connection dialog enumerates serial ports when it opens (button#ports-selected -> ul#serial-port-input-list; COM3..COM6 on this machine, matching /api/ports). There is nothing to refresh manually.

Connect.note: Per-tile toggle: div.device-tile .toggle-switch .disConnectedState reads 'Connect'; when connected the same switch reads 'Disconnect' / 'Open'. With several tiles the text is ambiguous - select the tile first.

Settings.note: Icon-only anchor (a#settings-banner): innerText is empty, title empty, no aria-label. CDP text lookup cannot click it. Menu that opens: heading 'Settings', 'Check For Updates', heading 'Theme', 'Light', 'Dark', 'Quit'.

Auto Updates.note: Does not exist in this build. The Settings menu has no auto-update switch, only the manual 'Check For Updates'.

Auto Updates status.note: No settings page. The only status is the popup div.update-software-popup: title 'NovAtel Application Suite Update', line 'NovAtel Application Suite is up to date' (or a new-version message), line 'Current Version: x.y.z', button 'Close'.

NovatEl Application Suite Update Novat.note: Region read: this literal is a CDP prefix trick that resolves to the whole dialog text (div.update-software-popup). Reading just 'NovAtel Application Suite Update' returns only the title; appending a fragment of the next line ('...Update Novat') forces the container match, so the value carries both the verdict line and 'Current Version: x.y.z'.

Firmware file.note: Inside the per-device Update window, not on the Manage page. The window only exists after the device is connected; Browse opens the native Open dialog.

Device > Update > Firmware file.note: The chosen file name shows up on the 'Select File' line after Browse. Help text: 'The Update window appears with the name of the selected file in the Select File field.'

Apply.note: In the per-device Update window. Irreversible: flashes firmware, receiver restarts.

Browse.note: Opens the native Windows Open dialog - not reachable over CDP.

New Connection.note: jQuery UI dialog title (span.ui-dialog-title) of the Add Device dialog.

Serial.note: li#serial inside ul#connection-type. Type choices are list items, not radio buttons: Network / Serial / USB. The 'Serial' panel heading (h3) only appears after the type is chosen.

Select.note: Placeholder text of the two custom dropdowns button#ports-selected (Port) and button#baudrate-selected (Baud Rate). Click the button, then click the option li (COM3..COM6 / Auto,115200,230400,460800,921600).

connection-name.note: input#connection-name name=connectionName maxlength=16. The CDP text driver cannot read input values, so the workflow reads the dialog region instead.

Connection Name Type.note: Region read: resolves to div.connection-content inside the New Connection dialog. Value looks like 'Connection Name Type Network Serial USB Serial Port COM4 Baud Rate 115200 Passive Hardware Handshake PIM222A Receiver' - that is how the workflow proves the Port/Baud choices stuck (input values are invisible to CDP).

Add.note: New Connection dialog submit. Disabled (class customDisableButton) until name+port+baud are set. The same word 'Add' is also the Add application dialog button - scope by the open dialog.

Graph.note: Home card div#Graph-welcome.application-container.GraphApp.standAloneApp. Clicking it starts the separate process Graph.exe (parent = NASRunner). No CDP page appears; Graph also strips --remote-debugging-port.

New Project.note: In the standalone Graph.exe welcome window (Graph i18n NEW_PROJECT). Not reachable over CDP.

Open Project.note: Graph welcome window (i18n OPEN_PROJECT); opens *.gpf via native Open dialog.

Create from SBF.note: Does not exist. Graph has no SBF/CSV chooser radio; the file is picked on the Receiver Data page via Select (native Open dialog). i18n only has NEW_PROJECT / OPEN_PROJECT.

Create from CSV.note: Does not exist, same as Create from SBF.

SBF file.note: Does not exist by that name. The wizard field is 'NovAtel Receiver Data File' on the Receiver Data page.

Project name.note: Graph Project Information page (i18n PROJECT_NAME). Next to it: Project Folder (chosen via 'Select' -> 'Select Folder' dialog) and Project Description (optional).

Process.note: Does not exist. Graph processes with the 'Plot' button (help text: 'Click the Plot button. The processing progress appears.').

Plot.note: Graph Pre-Process window. Writes the processed project; the human gate sits before it.

Finish.note: Graph File Validation page; 'Click "Finish" to launch the Graph overview'. This is NOT the processing step.

Graph > Pre-process > Flags.note: Bottom-left button of the Pre-Process window ('The number shown on the Flags button indicates the number of flags').

Graph > Projects > Current.note: Graph has a Home button and a Recent Projects list on the welcome window; there is no 'Projects' pane.

Add application.note: My Applications header button. Opens modal #popupModal.appInstallerPopup.

Import from your computer.note: div.import-offline-container in the Add application modal footer. Handler calls remote.dialog.showOpenDialog (title 'Open', filters: ZIP Files) - a native dialog, not reachable over CDP.

Application package.note: Does not exist. A local .zip is chosen through 'Import from your computer', not typed into a field.

Add application > Package.note: Does not exist. After import, the modal shows application cards (.app-card-container) titled with the application name.

Install.note: The Add application modal has no 'Install' button; it is 'Add' (class appAdd, disabled with customDisableAddBtn until a card is selected).

Update application.note: Only rendered when an update is offered: home banner button 'New noncore app version available' (or banner text 'Updates are available for N Applications', buttons Install / Dismiss). With 0 updates the node does not exist in the DOM at all (checked 2026-11-04).

Select the application(s) to update.note: Body text of the Update application popup (i18n SELECTUPDATEAPPTEXT). The add-mode twin is 'Select the application(s) to add'.

Update application > Application.note: The selectable item is the application card; its title is the application name, so the workflow reads that name directly.

My Applications > Installed.note: Home view: span.my-app-text 'My Applications' plus one div.application-container per app, name in span.appFullName (Manage / Playback / Convert / GRIT Monitor / Perception Viewer / Graph on this machine).

My Applications > Version.note: The home cards do not show a version in this build; the only version text is in the Check For Updates popup ('Current Version: x.y.z').
